title: AgentOS work tools
lede: AgentOS runs teams of AI agents against governed work orders, and the agents in those teams need a way to act inside that governance without being able to bend it. I gave them a deliberately narrow set of tools. The caller's identity fixes which work order, team and role it is acting for, so an agent cannot name a different work order or claim a different seat. Most actions take the path of a file the agent has written, so large plans and reviews stay on disk and the tool call stays small.
evidence: Agent orchestration tools: 11 tools that let governed agents author, validate and start work orders and act inside their team without being able to name another work order or seat.
Identity-scoped agent actions: the caller's identity fixes its work order, team and role; actions take file paths and return receipts, with outcomes delivered to the team lead's mailbox.
author: Corey James
